name: Vagharelo Bhaat
subtitle: yesterday's rice fried up with mustard seeds, potato and peas into a proper meal

ingredients.note: day-old rice from the fridge, grains separate
use compounded-free hing to keep this gluten-free

prepNotes: Use cold rice straight from the fridge. Fresh warm rice turns to paste the moment it hits the pan.
Break up any clumps with wet fingers before you start, so you are not doing it in a hot pan.
Dice the potato small (1cm) or it will still be raw when the rice is hot.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a kadhai and crackle the mustard seeds, then add the cumin, asafoetida, curry leaves and slit chillies.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes over medium-high heat until the edges colour.
Add the diced potato, turn to coat, cover and cook 6-7 minutes until a piece gives easily to a fork.
steps.tip: Cover the pan for this. The potato steams tender rather than frying dry and hard.

steps.text: Stir in the peas, turmeric and chilli powder and cook 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice, salt and sugar and fold gently with a flat spatula until every grain is yellow.
steps.tip: Fold, do not stir. A spoon stirred in circles smashes the grains.

steps.text: Raise the heat and leave the rice undisturbed for 2 minutes so the bottom layer catches slightly, then fold once.
Cook 2 minutes more until the rice is hot all the way through and smells toasted.
Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and coriander and serve with plain yogurt or chaas.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Reheat covered in a pan with 1 tbsp water over medium heat; the microwave dries the grains at the edges.
